summary: This directory defines the core TypeScript analysis schemas. It provides structural definitions for symbols, members, imports, exports, and types, enabling uniform representation of code metadata for documentation and analysis tools.
responsibilities: Define structural schemas for TypeScript code analysis
Model symbol identity and relationship metadata
Capture import, export, and member analysis data
Provide runtime validation and static type definitions
relationships: Symbol analysis serves as the root structure containing signature and dependency metadata.
Dependency candidates identify relationships between imported symbols and local declarations.
Member identities and accessors define the structural properties of class or interface members.
Import and export analyses categorize module-level connectivity and visibility.
Type structures are composed of foundational language constructs defined across the schema layer.
designDecisions: Use of schema-first definition for runtime validation and type inference
Modular decomposition of language constructs into distinct schema files
Dual representation of schemas as both constant objects and static TypeScript types
Hierarchical composition of metadata to support complex analysis
Standardized identity keys for tracking symbols across different analysis phases
